'''Cann Doon''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] who dealt with [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]]. He was present outside [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|Jabba's Palace]], unloading cargo from his ship supervised by [[Bidlo Kwerve/Legends|Bidlo Kwerve]], when a [[Jawa/Legends|Jawa]] [[Sandcrawler/Legends|sandcrawler]] approached. Doon was nervous about the approaching loud noise, and grabbed Kwerve's arm, spilling the other man's [[Corellian ale/Legends|Corellian ale]].
